sentences.text: Emission-Eye Oy is a cohort company registered on 2025-06-13 under the industry code 62100, computer programming activities.
Since then the record adds two exhibitor or demo entries, dated 2026-05-31 and 2026-08-19, and a patent filing dated 2026-05-31.
First sales are recorded on 2025-08-01, and a programme-entry record is dated 2026-02-09.
No Business Finland decision, EU project or public contract is on record, so the investment level is unknown rather than low.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, and more public evidence on investment readiness is needed before any introduction.
